Class Wall

java.lang.Object
moldsim.model.Wall
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Wall extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a 2D grid wall used in the simulation.

A wall is composed of cells arranged in a rectangular grid. It supports infection simulation, neighbor retrieval, and material-dependent behavior.
